_comment: Rungate's own conformity exemptions (#80). Each list is a RATCHET, not a mute: adding an entry that is not a real current violation fails, and an entry that stops being a violation must be removed or the build fails. Shrinking both lists to empty is the work. Consumers get their own file or none at all - these never travel.
_untestedSpecs: DRIFT-2 - testable specs with no test referencing them by name. Over half the testable surface. CONFIG-DIRECTORY-STRUCTURE-SPEC left this list in #274: test/consumer-ceremony-fixture.test.ts parses its Consumer Config Shape table and asserts the on-disk fixture conforms, and re-checks each documented fact against the source it describes, so the spec is now read by something that can go red. 7 entries down to 6. Delisting was not optional - the ratchet refuses a stale entry, so leaving it would have failed the build.
_orphanFiles: HYGIENE-3 - files with zero references anywhere. The two shell scripts may be dead or may be invoked in a way the reference scanner cannot see; that judgement was deliberately not made under a red gate. Resolve each by deleting, archiving to reference/, or referencing it - then delist.
